# Ecofit

> Ecofit (Ecofit Networks Inc.) is the equipment intelligence platform for fitness operators. It connects to the cardio and strength equipment across every location and turns it into real-time data on utilization, uptime, and maintenance, so operators can manage their entire floor from one place and defend capex decisions with numbers.

Ecofit is brand-agnostic and works with the equipment operators already own, through direct manufacturer integrations and universal wireless sensors. It serves single-site and multi-location operators, from one club to 500 locations. Ecofit Networks Inc. is headquartered in Victoria, British Columbia, Canada, and supports operators across North America.

## What Ecofit does
- Real-time equipment utilization, uptime, and status across every asset and location.
- Preventive maintenance scheduling and service tracking. Operators report a 30 to 40% reduction in unplanned service spend in the first year.
- Cross-location performance benchmarking and automated analytics (usage, availability, saturation, peak periods).
- Equipment inventory, transfer, and lifecycle tracking, from deployment to retirement.

## Products
- Platform: full equipment inventory, live status, custom maintenance scheduling, service tracking, and analytics. https://ecofitnetworks.com/platform
- Analytics: automated reporting that turns equipment data into decisions. https://ecofitnetworks.com/analytics
- Integrations: direct data from leading manufacturers, with no extra hardware for compatible units. https://ecofitnetworks.com/integrations

## Equipment integrations
Life Fitness, Matrix, Precor, Woodway, Concept2, CORE Health & Fitness, Octane Fitness, True Fitness, and Star Trac, plus universal wireless sensors for other brands. No rip and replace.

## Proof points
- About 40% average reduction in equipment refresh costs within 12 months of deployment.
- 3.2x longer equipment lifespan on assets under Ecofit management.
- 200+ assets networked per facility on average across the Ecofit operator network.

## Who it is for
Multi-location gym chains, franchises, single-site clubs, and boutique studios that want to run equipment and floor decisions on data instead of instinct.
